say:1:1524617001:0.text: This morning, a boy slipped after the hunters into the forest.
say:1:1524617001:0.source_cn: 今早狩猎队传来了消息，说有一个不懂狩猎的孩子，跟着他们...
say:1:1524617001:0.male: This morning, a boy slipped after the hunters into the forest.
say:1:1524617001:0.female: This morning, a boy slipped after the hunters into the forest.

say:2:1524617002:1.text: The boy's name is <style="highlight">Smallspot</style>. He recently joined my magic class, brimming with passion and eager to test every spell he learns.
say:2:1524617002:1.male: The boy's name is <style="highlight">Smallspot</style>. He recently joined my magic class, brimming with passion and eager to test every spell he learns.

say:3:1524617003:1.text: I suspect he snuck into the forest to try the expulsion magic he just learned yesterday. But at his current proficiency... I'm far from confident.
say:3:1524617003:1.source_cn: 我猜他今天跑去森林，估计是想试试昨天刚学的驱逐魔法。但...
